The equation a2+8a=48 can be written in the form (a+p)2=q. Find p+q, and solve the equation.

a
p+q=64,a=−12 and a=−4
b
p+q=60,a=12 and a=−8
c
p+q=68,a=−12 and a=4
d
p+q=64,a=−12 and a=4
e
p+q=68,a=12 and a=−4
